Greenhouse - Effectively and measurably, make smarter hiring decisions
Greenhouse is the leading hiring software for growing companies. Thousands of the most successful companies, like DoorDash, Betterment, Wayfair and DocuSign, use Greenhouse to optimize all aspects of their hiring and onboarding. With our powerful hiring approach, complete suite of software and services, and large integration ecosystem, your company will be ready to hire for what is next.
Greenhouse Recruiting drives engaging candidate interactions at every touchpoint, eliminates administrative burden and keeps everyone on the hiring team engaged. Greenhouse also leads the industry in diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) tools, helping to mitigate bias and create a fairer hiring process. Greenhouse customers see an average of 85% company-wide engagement, a 27% improvement in average time to hire and a 31% reduction in average cost per hire.
With Greenhouse you can:
Build and orchestrate a great hiring plan
Empower recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers and referrers to play their part with unique permission levels
Identify the best-performing sources and optimize your approach
Shorten time to hire by winning at every interaction
Curate every touchpoint with candidates
Use analytics to drive continuous improvements
